info.title: MICROSERVICE-apiwizruntimedoc-List Loyalty Loyalty Rules-v2-spec
info.description: The List Loyalty Rules API provides businesses with critical insights into their loyalty program's configurations. By retrieving comprehensive details about loyalty rules, organizations can tailor their customer engagement strategies effectively. This API is particularly beneficial for marketing teams and program administrators aiming to understand the conditions under which customers earn rewards. It serves as a key resource for optimizing customer retention and enhancing the overall loyalty program experience.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch the current loyalty rules defined in the system. It provides detailed information about the criteria and benefits associated with the loyalty program.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve the loyalty rules. Make sure to provide the necessary data in the specified format to successfully get the rules associated with the loyalty program.

ListLoyaltyLoyaltyRulesRequest.description: This schema represents the request body for the GET operation on loyalty rules. It is represented as a simple string.
